purpose: Graded outcomes for The Desk's predictions. This file is the reason the public track record can exist: buildLedgerFromDays() re-attaches these on every rebuild, so grading survives instead of being erased (the S308 defect). Every graded resolution carries an evidence URL — grading a persona right or wrong on the desk's own say-so would be the same unfalsifiable punditry the stance rules already reject.
